note: DP-28: on a file system without hard links publish places the handoff by an exclusive create plus read-back; when that write fails after its own exclusive open made the file, publish removes that file (its own partial, matched by device and inode) and fails, so handoff-state answers publish-failed and a retry of the stage fills the claim at the claimed path. A partial left by a killed process is never removed or replaced (D-8): the publish is refused handoff-exists and handoff-state answers publish-failed. Test seams: STORE_TEST_PUBLISH_NOLINK, STORE_TEST_PUBLISH_FAIL (test mode only).
